title: Evolve to Learn: Gradient-aligned experience evolution for model self-improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.32390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving language models can continuously acquire useful experience through test-time interaction, reflection, and prompt optimization, yet turning such experience into model itself to ensure self improvement remains challenging. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides a natural mechanism for internalizing test-time information into model parameters, yet it largely assumes that the gener- ated experience is worth learning. We show that this assumption does not always hold: experiences that improve test-time performance may provide limited or even harmful training signals. translated_title: 进化以学习：面向模型自我改进的梯度对齐经验进化方法
translated_abstract: 自进化语言模型可以通过测试时交互、反思和提示优化持续获取有用经验，然而如何将这些经验转化为模型自身的能力以确保自我改进仍然具有挑战性。在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）为将测试时信息内化到模型参数中提供了一种自然的机制，但它很大程度上假设所生成的经验是值得学习的。我们证明这一假设并不总是成立：能够提升测试时性能的经验可能提供有限甚至有害的训练信号。为了更好地刻画哪些经验应该被内化，我们系统地分析了跨多个任务和反思模型的多样化变异经验，发现基于梯度的对齐度是比即时的测试时性能提升更可靠的下游蒸馏收益指标。基于这一发现，我们提出了E2L，一种自进化方法框架。
tldr: 该论文揭示了一个关键问题：能提升测试时性能的经验并不一定值得内化到模型中，并提出以梯度对齐作为更可靠的经验筛选标准，据此构建了E2L自进化框架来实现模型的自我改进。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that experiences improving test-time performance do not necessarily provide useful training signals, and proposes gradient-based alignment as a more reliable criterion for selecting experiences to internalize, leading to the E2L self-evolution framework for model self-improvement.
